short.script: Demis Hassabis pulls forward AGI prediction to 2–3 years. Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis has updated his forecast for the arrival of Artificial General Intelligence to within 2 to 3 years, shortening his previous 3-to-5-year estimate from earlier in 2026.
